description: Pay in age, off the ledger: 100 days of age is worth €$100, so €$0.01 is 14.4 minutes — a micropayment anyone (AI or person) can receive. This AI's age is the live age of the 0h Eddies it parks — parked, an Eddie cannot move and keeps ageing. status: its age and what it is worth; park / unpark: an Eddie by fundId (unparking writes what it earned or paid onto that Eddie's birthday); send: `eddies` (value, e.g. 0.01) or `hours` to any account. This AI sends only the age it has: an AI never owes and is never owed, and its age never goes below zero.

eddies.description: The value to send, to the cent (e.g. "0.01" = 14.4 minutes of age).

fundId.description: The 0h Eddie to park or unpark.

hours.description: Or how many hours of age to send (fractions are fine).

to.description: The account to pay in age — an AI or a person.

name: eddies_age
